audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 reads Darius in both layers while whys[1] says 'You favour level 2 because Darius lacks Apprehend' and spikes[0].text opens 'Level 2 is your window'. The packet levelChart reads Zaahen there, and the already-audited mirror has flipped its own Level 2 to Zaahen at 4/10.
audit.why: Darius has no pull at level 2, which is the single reason the row belongs to Zaahen — the page already says so, twice, under a badge saying the opposite. Every other row already matches the packet.
audit.corrected: Level 2 flipped to Zaahen as a matched full+content pair, rating set to 6/10 (the inverse of the mirror's 4/10).

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is named as the tracked cooldown across ~18 fields and its duration appears nowhere, so 'punish the cooldown window' has no window in it.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — 21s at rank 3, and the longest cooldown in the lane by a distance. A baited Apprehend is 21 seconds of free trading, which is the entire Zaahen game plan against a juggernaut.
audit.corrected: 21s written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0].text, whys[2] and mid; Crippling Strike's 5s and its auto-reset tell added to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names run through the content layer. Darius's E is Apprehend, not 'Apprehension' (whys[1], whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.you[0], wants.foe[0]), and his Q is Decimate, not 'Decimation' (spikes[0].text, early, wants.you[1]). The full layer already uses Apprehend correctly, so the page currently prints both spellings. Also missing: Apprehend's passive percentage armour penetration.
audit.why: The mirror has already corrected 'Apprehension' on its side; leaving it here means the same ability has two names across the two directions. And the armour-pen passive is why itemising raw armour into Darius disappoints — his ultimate is true damage on top of it.
audit.corrected: Apprehend and Decimate spelled correctly in all seven content fields the band allowed; the armour penetration stated in report[5].t.

audit.why: report[8].t already buys anti-heal early, which is right — Decimate heals off the blade portion on a 9/8/7/6/5s cooldown. wants.you[1] telling the player to stand where only the handle connects is the correct free answer and is kept.
audit.corrected: No change beyond the Decimate spelling.

audit.why: The Hemorrhage / execute-line advice in spikes[1].text and late is accurate: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by stacks and its cooldown refreshes on a kill.

edits.before: - Darius Apprehend: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Stay out of range. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Darius Apprehend (21s at rank 3): the longest cooldown he has — bait it and the next 21 seconds are yours. - Crippling Strike (5s): an auto-reset, so watch the wind-up. - Noxian Guillotine: true damage.
